lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regular grid-like array of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately 6 horizontal rows and 15 vertical columns posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of blobs to form a structured, repeating grid across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Prominent horizontal ridge extending from the post-branchial region to the caudal peduncle, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with higher intensity on the dorsal side of the ridge crest.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance spots located primarily on the lower half of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A notable high-luminance white marking is present on the posterior margin of the first dorsal fin; several small, elongated white features (likely ectoparasites) are visible on the mid-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remoras are visible in the ventral region, with the largest specimen positioned directly below the posterior edge of the pectoral fin.
